channel.title: MythicNames Blog
channel.description: Guides, tips and inspiration for naming characters, places and worlds.

item.title: D&D NPC Names: The Name + Trade Formula & 60+ Table-Ready Names
item.description: How to name an NPC in five seconds without breaking the scene: the name-plus-trade formula, why occupational surnames work, sayability, and the phone-book method.

item.title: Fantasy Surnames: The Four Sources & 75+ Family Names
